## analyzeIncremental() function

Perform incremental analysis by re-analyzing only affected portions of the graph.

This is intended to be more efficient than full analysis when only a small portion of the graph has changed. Currently, this is a stub that delegates to full analysis - true incremental analysis is planned for future implementation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function analyzeIncremental(graph: MigrationGraph, _previousResult: AnalysisResult, _changedFiles: readonly string[]): AnalysisResult;
```

## Remarks

Future implementation will: - Identify which versions and migrations are affected by changed files - Recompute only the field profiles that could have changed - Preserve diagnostics for unaffected portions of the graph

## Example


```typescript
const initialResult = analyzeGraph(graph);
// ... later, after changes ...
const updatedResult = analyzeIncremental(
  graph,
  initialResult,
  ['src/migrations/v2-to-v3.ts']
);
```
